title: Analyzing Image Encoder Choices and Graph Homophily in GCN Frameworks for Breast Ultrasound Classification
abstract: arXiv:2607.12054v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Breast ultrasound is widely used for screening, yet automated analysis remains challenging due to speckle noise, acquisition variability, and weak separation of benign and malignant cases in standard ultrasound imaging. Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach by leveraging relationships among similar patient samples. However, it remains unclear how the choice of image encoder influences graph construction and downstream classification performance. In this work, we systematically evaluate five image encoders spanning convolutional and transformer-based architectures for GCN-based breast ultrasound classification. Image embeddings are used to construct cosine similarity k-nearest-neighbor graphs, which are classified using a single-layer GCN with a linear classification head. translated_title: 基于GCN框架的乳腺超声分类中图像编码器选择与图同质性分析
translated_abstract: 乳腺超声被广泛用于临床筛查，但由于斑点噪声、采集条件的变异性以及标准超声成像中良恶性病例特征区分度较弱，自动化分析仍然面临挑战。图卷积网络（GCNs）近期作为一种有前景的方法兴起，其通过利用相似患者样本之间的关系进行建模。然而，图像编码器的选择如何影响图的构建以及下游分类性能，目前仍不明确。在本工作中，我们系统地评估了五种图像编码器（涵盖卷积架构和基于Transformer的架构）在基于GCN的乳腺超声分类任务中的表现。图像嵌入被用于构建余弦相似度的k近邻图，随后通过一个带有线性分类头的单层GCN进行分类。在三个患者级交叉验证折中，容量更高的编码器持续改善了图同质性，并（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究系统评估了五种图像编码器对基于GCN的乳腺超声分类的影响，发现容量更高的编码器能够持续提升图同质性和分类性能。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates five image encoders for GCN-based breast ultrasound classification, showing that higher-capacity encoders consistently improve graph homophily and downstream classification performance.
